status: PROPOSED protocol; takes effect only for a family the owner registers; T1-T10 and all existing protocols are untouched

levels.name: Predictive signal
levels.question: Does a pre-registered, point-in-time signal rank next-period returns across liquid spot assets better than chance?
levels.claim_type: signal existence (cross-sectional), not a trading claim
levels.data: PIT daily klines of the eligible universe; evaluation window inside the research bounds; holdout excluded
levels.statistic: mean daily cross-sectional IC with Newey-West standard error (lag fixed ex ante) and a circular block bootstrap as check
levels.multiplicity_correction: Holm across all pre-registered configurations and horizons of the family
levels.rejection_criteria: not rejected at one-sided 5 % after Holm, OR IC sign unstable in more than half of the pre-registered sub-periods, OR signal rank-correlation with a rejected-family signal above 0.7 (disguise check), OR a lookahead/survivorship test fails
levels.budget_accounting: each pre-registered configuration counts once toward N; the family consumes one family slot
levels.what_passing_does_not_mean: nothing about profit, costs, capacity, risk limits or T1-T10; not a validated strategy

levels.name: Economic viability
levels.question: Does a long-only spot portfolio built from the L1 signal earn more than comparators after realistic costs?
levels.data: same as L1 plus engine costs (fee 0.1 %, slippage 0.05 %, 2x stress), participation cap, minimum notional
levels.statistic: paired active return versus cash, BTC buy-and-hold, PIT equal weight and an exposure-matched comparator, HAC/block inference
levels.multiplicity_correction: Holm across comparators; comparators that are ex-post are labelled non-tradable and never gate
levels.rejection_criteria: net active return not positive at the pre-registered level under 2x costs, OR break-even cost below 2x the assumed cost, OR drawdown breach of the 20 % T4 limit under risk layer V3 with zero recovery
levels.budget_accounting: no new N if the configuration is unchanged; any change is a new configuration
levels.what_passing_does_not_mean: not robustness (L3), not operational reliability (L4), not T1-T10 validation

levels.name: Robustness
levels.question: Does the L2 result survive other assets, periods and regimes?
levels.data: pre-registered disjoint sub-universes, sub-periods and bull/bear/sideways regimes defined ex ante
levels.statistic: sign and size of the net active return per slice, dependence-aware
levels.null_hypothesis: result is concentrated in one slice
levels.multiplicity_correction: Holm across slices; no slice may be added or removed after seeing results
levels.rejection_criteria: fewer than the pre-registered number of slices positive, OR any single slice drives the result
levels.budget_accounting: slices of an already registered configuration add no N
levels.what_passing_does_not_mean: not forward evidence; history is shared by all slices

levels.name: Forward paper trading and operations
levels.question: Does the system run reliably and match its own backtest in forward time without real money?
levels.data: licence-cleared live feed (requires resolved data licensing)
levels.statistic: signal/order/fill reconciliation, tracking error versus the engine, incident log
levels.rejection_criteria: unreconciled orders, risk-layer breach, data gap not handled, or tracking error above the pre-registered bound
levels.budget_accounting: none (no new experiment), but any signal change restarts L1
levels.what_passing_does_not_mean: not a profitability proof: forward time accrues about one year per year

levels.name: Controlled live deployment
levels.question: Is limited-capital live trading acceptable?
levels.rejection_criteria: unreachable without a separate written owner approval
levels.what_passing_does_not_mean: L5 is a label only; S9 does not define or enable it

non_implication_rules: passing level k is reported as 'passed L{k}' only; a statement that implies a higher level is a defect
levels are entered in order after an accepted written outcome of the previous level
a signal that passes L1-L3 is not a strategy validated under T1-T10 and is never reclassified as one
no rejected strategy or family is re-tested or reclassified by the ladder
the holdout (2025-07-01 to 2026-11-25) stays untouched; whether and how it is used is a separate owner decision after L3
no profitability claim may be made from L1 or L2 alone
researcher_degrees_of_freedom: one universe rule, one formula and one fixed scalar per configuration, written before any market data of the candidate is read
evaluation window, sub-periods, regimes, comparators and the stop rule fixed in the pre-registration
no assets, periods or horizons dropped or added after seeing results
a market-derived summary statistic of a candidate signal computed before pre-registration counts as an experiment and is forbidden
stop rule: if L1 is not rejected for a registered configuration, the hypothesis terminates; no variant search
